The '''FullSpec sensor package''' was installed in the [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd]] [[RLG guardian droid system]]. It provided full visual, [[Infrared/Legends|infrared]], and [[Ultraviolet/Legends|ultraviolet]] scanning capability, along with a [[Motion sensor|motion detector]].
